alt: Cyclist hauling a bicycle up a flight of concrete stairs beneath the Henry Hudson Parkway overpass to access the Hudson River Greenway, with the new empty protected bike lane visible below
story: NYC DOT installed a protected bike lane on Riverside Drive in Inwood that funnels cyclists to a flight of stairs with no bike runnel, because the community board vetoed the simpler route to preserve 40 parking spaces — so cyclists carry their bikes up the stairs or skip the new lane entirely.
why_funny: The official answer to 'we can't lose 40 parking spots' was a fully engineered protected bike lane that still requires cyclists to hump their bikes up a flight of stairs — which they don't, so the shiny new lane sits empty.
